# Sree AI

> Sree AI is a unified next-generation multimodal artificial intelligence platform. It seamlessly integrates open-weight Large Language Models (75+ models including DeepSeek-V3, Llama 3.3, Qwen 2.5), ultra-low latency real-time voice synthesis (sub-50ms via distributed Edge WebSockets), studio-grade photorealistic image generation (FLUX.1 & Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro), 4K video generation (Google Veo 3.1 & Google Omni Flash), 2D-to-3D spatial mesh converter, and an AI text humanizer. Sree AI provides native Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) support allowing users to route API calls directly through NVIDIA, Google, Groq, and Deepgram with 0% platform markups, as well as full private cloud and on-premise self-hostability.

## Core Platform Tools

- [Sree Chat](https://app.sreeai.qzz.io): Unified intelligence suite featuring 75+ open-weight LLMs, full context retrieval, coding assistance, and reasoning benchmarks.
- [Sree Voice](https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/voice): Sub-50ms ultra-low latency real-time voice streaming engine built on persistent bidirectional WebSockets and distributed edge nodes.
- [Sree Image](https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/image): Photorealistic graphics and concept art generator powered by FLUX.1 and Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro models.
- [Sree Video](https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/video): High-fidelity 4K motion synthesis and camera physics powered by Google Veo 3.1 and Google Omni Flash.
- [2D to 3D Convertor](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#tools): Spatial 3D asset generation transforming 2D imagery into clean, production-ready OBJ/GLTF 3D meshes (Coming Soon).
- [AI Humanizer & Enhancer](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#tools): AI text naturalization tool that eliminates robotic syntactic patterns and enhances text clarity (Coming Soon).

## Official Downloads & Client Applications

- [Sree AI Web App (PWA)](https://app.sreeai.qzz.io/?install=true): Installable Progressive Web App for Desktop Dock, Windows Taskbar, and Mobile Home Screen.
- [Android APK Download](https://sreeai.qzz.io/downloads/sree-ai.apk): Standalone APK binary for Android 8.0+ devices (Version v1.0.0, ~942 KB, SHA-256: `ae6d6d05b13d370a64df281e17c6a5490abc677a031dfe7d007ac2f225743140`).
- [macOS Universal App Download](https://sreeai.qzz.io/downloads/sree-ai-mac.zip): Standalone ZIP package for macOS 12.0+ supporting Apple Silicon (M1–M4) and Intel (Version v1.0.0, ~1.0 MB, SHA-256: `07ab455e79d546b1a559c49ed1f250b3cc549a626c68a4c05c3a2e1a4b737ce5`).
- [Upcoming Native Clients](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#download): Apple TestFlight for iOS/iPadOS and Windows Desktop 64-bit clients in active preparation.

## Architecture & Capabilities

- [BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#architecture): Secure client-side credential encryption allowing direct routing through NVIDIA Cloud, Google Gemini, Groq, and Deepgram (Anthropic & OpenAI coming soon).
- [Self-Hostable Infrastructure](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#faq): Complete dockerized frontend, API gateway, and edge worker containers deployable inside AWS VPC, GCP, or private on-prem bare metal.
- [Data Retention Policies](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#pricing): 30-day auto-purge on Free tier, 3-month retention on Starter tier, and permanent storage on Pro tier.

## Pricing & Subscription Tiers (Global USD & Indian INR)

- [Free Plan ($0 or ₹0/mo)](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#pricing): 18+ models, 10 chats/day, 20 voice requests/day, 5 image generations/day, BYOK enabled, 30 days storage auto-delete.
- [Starter Plan ($8/mo or ₹399/mo | $6.40/mo or ₹319/mo billed annually)](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#pricing): 70+ models, 50 chats/day, 60 voice requests/day, 30 images/day, 10 videos/day, BYOK enabled, 3 months storage, access to all tools.
- [Pro Plan ($29/mo or ₹899/mo | $23.20/mo or ₹719/mo billed annually)](https://sreeai.qzz.io/#pricing): 75+ models, 200 chats/day, 100 voice requests/day, 70 images/day, 30 videos/day, highest priority GPU queues, permanent storage, dedicated 24/7 VIP developer support.
